script_text: Stop! Aquarius, your ruling planet Uranus is about to crack open your 5th House of romance like a whip. As an Air sign, you’ll try to intellectualize the tension, but your body knows the truth. In love, if you’re taken, expect a sudden revelation about a partner’s hidden motive; if single, attract someone bold now who challenges your usual type. Career-wise, Mars in your 10th House pushes you to claim authority this afternoon, but avoid signing contracts under this square—wait until Mercury stations direct. A surprise bonus could appear through a friend’s referral, your 11th House of networks lighting up. Do not ignore a gut warning about a joint investment tonight. Follow for tomorrow’s reading.
